A subject matter expert with almost 30 years of work experience in diverse fields of Aviation ranging from aircraft manufacturing & maintenance to passenger service delivery. headings.text:
The Operational Readiness and Airport Transfer (ORAT) consulting methodology is designed to ensure that a new airport 
						infrastructure project – a terminal extension or a newbuild on a greenfield site functions perfectly from the
						very beginning. We offer ORAT (Operational Readiness and Transfer) consulting services and optimization of airports with 
						a focus on Terminal Planning, Airport Processes as well as the management of complex airport projects.
						Key Deliverables of our consulting services are to enhance the passenger experience as well as operational 
						efficiency at airports. By using a holistic approach which incorporates the requirements of internal and external
						stakeholders, we contribute to the success of our clients. We ensure the clients and its operational teams are ready to deal with two main sets of tasks: Preparing staff, procedures and systems; and Planning a smooth transfer from the old to the new installation. This all starts with operational and technical management, with the team writing new
                        sets of operational concepts and procedures, or updating existing ones, to suit the new 
                        installation. Ground handling, control center operation, different types of emergency 
                        response – everything is considered. Next comes training and familiarization: checking there is adequate training documentation
                        to educate staff in these new processes, concepts and technical systems. Lastly, there is the design of the operational trials that verify system functionality and check 
                        new airport processes for gaps and errors. The ORAT team plans the script for each one down 
                        to the very last detail, from the staff involved and the flight schedule to sourcing the dummy 
                        bags and test passengers, seamless working of access control systems, complex working of fire 
                        safety and protection systems and even arranging the temporary catering and fueling services. Moving to a new facility is a huge test but it also offers airport and airline operators and other 
                        relevant stakeholders like CUSTOMS, Immigrations, Security Agencies, fueling and catering companies;
                        the opportunity to massively improve their procedures, systems and staff skills in a single step. With our experience of working on different airport projects and playing critical role at some of the 
                        world’s largest operating airport from “ORAT Planning to Execution”, ensures that we are in line with 
                        global best practice, and can formulate practical, hands-on trials that ensure reality matches the 
                        initial vision with smooth operational transition.

headings.text:
Aero Opt facilitate the prediction of the passenger flow demand for planning purposes (monthly, weekly, next day) as well
						as for real time terminal operations based on planned/actual flights, processes (also health check etc.) and rules
						(include social-distancing). Specially trained algorithms determine the resource requirements to achieve defined 
						quality targets (Level of Service – LOS / Level of Health – LOH) for the passenger flow demand and enable an appropriate 
						deployment of human resources in order to minimize variable operational cost while still meeting quality targets. Aero Opt uses cast modelling to simulate passenger flows through the terminal in order to predict the potential
						impact of peak hourly flows on the processing facilities. This software will inform the Airport and/ or the Airline
						Operator, if there will be a need to introduce certain measures to address peak/extra ordinary peak periods, 
						which may result in having to introduce additional temporary processors to maintain passenger flows and ensure 
						the level of service is unaffected. Key advantages of using AeroOpt as a resource Management and predictive Analysis Tool includes: : High potentially to reduce cost and create high ROI through extending the life of the asset through a ‘predict and prevent’ approach. Maximizing asset utilization with capacity planning and floor management Notifications and Alerts Interface Stimulates performance to adjust for increased passenger volumes Allows you to test, monitor, simulate and plan for the future Being a web-based tool, this tool can be accessed, edited and shared accurately in real time. Realtime resource allocation Aero Opt aims to become the most Trusted Source of Data, to support the resource optimization planning tool for aviation
                        sector and a system of communication of authentic product data provided to its customers using resource optimization as 
                        a key planning tool in day to day operational requirements. Aero Opt allows to analyse potential scenarios on a scalable level of detail: Starting with a top-down approach, which 
                        could be a pure allocation task, further analysis steps could look at the requirements for passenger handling facilities.
                        Finally, detailed layout questions can be answered, e.g. how adapted passenger flows, new and changed processes and related
                        queuing systems can be organized in the most efficient and rule-compliant way. Quantitative results allow informed 
                        decision making and visualisation facilitates stakeholder discussion and communication. Possible scenarios and measures
                        are developed and tested while significantly accelerating the planning process and minimizing risks of decision making.

					comply with stakeholder requirements related to quality, health and safety, environmental management, corporate social
					responsibility and other areas of sustainable development. With massive media coverage and huge public interest, 
					finding ways to operate in a responsible manner is becoming increasingly important. we are assisting organizations
					to be kinder to the environment, have a positive impact on society and achieve greater economic sustainability.
The services are presently being offered to :- 1. AeroWash, Sweden 2. TaxiBot – India 3. Stelia 4. UPES, Dehradun 5. Robotic Disinfectant and Aircraft Sanitization System (UV-C)
CLIENT NAME : AEROWASH, SWEDEN OPERATIONAL AIRPORT : New Delhi, Dubai,Kuala Lampur

Project Description : AeroTech Support Services had partnered with AEROWASH, a Swedish manufacturer for providing aircraft
                    detailing services to Indian Carriers with use of latest technology aimed at enhancing airlines commitments towards greener
                    projects whilst improving operational performance for its fleet. Our team members have over 04 years of experience in successful implementation of Aerowash - Robotic Arircraft Exterior 
                    Dry-Wash Services for Airlines operating in INDIA, MALAYSIA and DUBAI Region. AeroTech Support Services hold special 
                    rights for implementing the solution in Middle East, Soth East Asia, INDIA and SARC Region. The Robotic cleaning 
                    
                    aircraft Dry wash solution is first of its kind with Aerotech in-depth know how of the system results in smooth
                    transition from water based non-measurable practice to more scientific approach towards cleaning aircraft, 
                    thereby resulting in measurable reduction in ATF consumption, Reduced Emissions and Zero water wastage while 
                    making the service available for airlines at parking stands.
CLIENT NAME : TAXIBOT-INDIA OPERATIONAL AIRPORT : DELHI, BANGALORE, HYDERABAD AIRPORT

Project Description : AeroTech Support Services Had Been Instrumental In Developing Market For TaxiBot In India Which 
                    Includes Obtaining Regulatory Compliances, Approvals From OEM (Airbus And Boeing), Performing Operational
                    Evaluation And Delivering A Final Product To Our Client. “WORLD’S FIRST TAXIBOT OPERATIONS WITH AIRBUS (A321 Family) AND BOEING (B737-NG Family)”.
CLIENT NAME : STELIA OPERATIONAL AIRPORT : New Delhi

CLIENT NAME : UNIVERSITY OF PETROLEUM & ENEREGY STUDIES, INDIA OPERATIONAL AIRPORT : Delhi

Project Description : AeroTech Support Services Had Partnered With UPES, Dehradun, A Premier Aviation Research Institute For 
                    Providing Research And Aviation Consulting To Students And Faculty Helping Them Understand The Dynamic Aviation Industry.
